capture_time_note: December 2013 is Common Crawl capture time, not publication time.

production_policy.coverage: Use every eligible story and every materially distinct information unit traceably.
production_policy.theme_policy: One initial installment per populated theme; editorial subtheme splits may be added when the evidence naturally requires them.
production_policy.source_policy: Full recovered source text is the factual authority; analysis cards are evidence maps rather than summaries that bound the script.
production_policy.incomplete_source_policy: Keep useful fragments, label gaps, and never invent a missing beginning, ending, identity, place, or event.

next_gate: Recover and export all 422 canonical captures, then ingest and analyze the 444 full-source story units.
